title: Ask Celerp AI a question
summary: Celerp AI answers questions about your business data in your own language, from a Cloud Relay or AI plan.

steps.text: Open {ai} from the sidebar. Without an active Cloud Relay or AI plan it shows example conversations, so you can see what it does before you subscribe.
Once a plan is active, type a question in your own language in the box at the bottom and send it; you can also drop a receipt, PDF or spreadsheet onto the box for the assistant to read.
The {plan} card on this page lists what a paid plan adds over the free showcase: more monthly questions, batch invoice processing, and letting the assistant create records for you.
